about_short_description.short_description: Dopal is a web platform that enable users to explore, compare and book personalized Activities and Experience.

product.name: Dopal Online Activity Booking Platform
product.description: A web platform that allows users to discover, compare, and book various activities and experiences across Egypt.

product.name: Personalized Activity Recommendations
product.description: A service that provides users with tailored activity suggestions based on their preferences and profile information.

product.name: Activity Provider Listings and Information
product.description: A comprehensive catalog of activities and experiences offered by various service providers, including detailed descriptions, pricing, and availability.

product.name: Secure Online Payment Processing
product.description: A payment service integrated into the platform that enables users to pay for activities securely using credit cards and other payment methods.

product.name: User Account and Booking Management
product.description: A feature that allows users to create profiles, save preferences, manage bookings, and access past activity history.
